create.name: Jeannie O’Neill
create.bio:
Jeannie O’Neill is a Kundalini and vinyasa yoga teacher, mindfulness meditation instructor and Ayurvedic practitioner based in Ithaca, New York. She co-founded Yoga Farm Ithaca, which grew out of a farm studio opened in 2015 and became a nonprofit in 2018, and she remains its executive director and lead educator. Her master's degree in education centred on contemplative teaching and curriculum design, and she is now working on a doctorate in transformational leadership, looking at how shared leadership and contemplative practice shape adult learning.

Like most Kundalini teachers in the United States she came up through Kundalini Research Institute trainings, but she has since built a guru-free approach that treats the practice as exploration rather than doctrine, with options offered and consent-based cueing. She wrote and leads the school's Radiant Warrior, Kundalini Warrior and Spiritual Warrior teacher trainings, which bring together Kundalini, Ayurveda, the Enneagram and lunar archetypes, along with shorter recorded courses on sadhana, numerology and the chakras. Classes run online and at the studio in Ithaca's West End, and she hosts retreats in Puerto Rico and Scotland. At Kripalu she leads a weekend joining Kundalini practice with Gandhi's idea of satyagraha, the force of truth.

courses.title: Awakening Through Truth: A Kundalini and Satyagraha Immersion
courses.description: A three-day residential programme at Kripalu built on Kundalini yoga and satyagraha, the path of truthful and conscious action. Days combine movement, breathwork, meditation, periods of silence, devotion, reflection and service.

courses.title: Kundalini Warrior Yoga Teacher Training (200 Hour)
courses.description: A twelve-week live online 200-hour Kundalini training for women, registered with Yoga Alliance. She is the lead educator; the course teaches breath, mantra and movement without guru hierarchy and asks for daily practice.

courses.title: Spiritual Warrior 300-Hour Advanced Teacher Training
courses.description: A 24-week live online advanced training open to teachers with a 200-hour qualification already in hand. It layers Kundalini, Ayurveda, the Enneagram and lunar archetypes, and includes how to hold ceremony and sacred space.

courses.title: Mountain Alchemy Retreat - Puerto Rico 2027
courses.description: Six days in the central mountains of Puerto Rico with dawn qigong, standing meditation and progressive breathwork sessions. River time and a visit to a Taíno petroglyph site are part of the week.

courses.title: Jupitarian Sadhana
courses.description: A recorded Kundalini sadhana she leads, using movement, breath, mantra and meditation. The practice is aimed at opening the heart and connecting with a sense of abundance.

courses.title: Tantric Numerology
courses.description: A self-paced course on the numerology used in Kundalini yoga, paired with practices for each number. It counts for ten Yoga Alliance continuing education hours.

courses.title: Kundalini 102 - A Chakra Journey
courses.description: A recorded series that moves up through the chakras from root to crown, with a Kundalini practice for each centre and a recipe to go with it.

courses.title: Yoga Farm Ithaca Online Membership
courses.description: Membership of the nonprofit's online school, with live and recorded yoga, qigong and meditation classes on Zoom, monthly workshops and new and full moon gatherings. A free tier and a three-day trial are offered.
courses.price: $25 USD per month or $225 USD per year

free_resources.title: Kundalini 101
free_resources.description: A free self-paced introduction to Kundalini yoga, with kriyas, breath practices and meditations taught in a guru-free way and kept indefinitely once you enrol.
